answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one lotus weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The cipher report reveals the merge explicitly at each saffron. Because of that, an farming party who spins up 182 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 76 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3078 identities would post 4613 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
